title: DataQualityFinding
description: One persisted, versioned finding about observed or projected data.

dedupeKey.description: Replay-stable identity of the rule failure and its evidence.

evidenceDigest.description:
Optional digest of candidate values or other stable evidence context.
Including this distinguishes changed invalid values for the same rule
and subject while leaving volatile timestamps out of the key.

firstSeen.description: When this finding was first observed.

id.description: Stable id derived from the dedupe key.

lastSeen.description: When this finding was most recently observed.

outcome.description: Typed result and evidence for the failed expectation.

provenance.description: Source records and observations that contributed to the finding.

ruleRef.description: The declared constraint or built-in rule, including its version.

subjects.description: Objects affected by the finding, sorted by type and key.

DataQualityFindingStatus.description: The lifecycle state of a data quality finding.

oneOf.description: The finding has not been reviewed or resolved.
A person or process accepted responsibility for the finding.
The latest data no longer exhibits the finding.
A newer finding or rule version replaced this finding.

DataQualityLineage.description: One source and observation lineage contributing evidence to a finding.

observationIds.description: Stable ids of observations that contributed to this evidence.

DataQualityOutcome.description: The result of evaluating a rule or constraint against data.

oneOf.description: An invariant expression evaluated to `false`.
The expression produced a non-boolean value.

actual.description: The expression value's stable debug form.

oneOf.description: The expression could not be evaluated under the admitted runtime.
An observed lifecycle state was outside the declared transition graph.

from.description: The current lifecycle state, or `None` when starting from initial.

reason.description: Why no unique shortest path reached the observed state.

state.description: The state reported by the source.

oneOf.description: An external observation contained a value that violates temporal rules.

value.description: The exact invalid value reported by the source.

oneOf.description: A row was excluded from the trusted identity projection.

code.description: Stable code for the identity projection defect.

detail.description: Concise reason that omits property values.

DataQualityRuleRef.description: A stable reference to the constraint or rule that produced a finding.

oneOf.description: An EntityIR invariant pinned by artifact version or declaration digest.

invariantId.description: The invariant identity within its owner.

owner.description: The object type or interface that declares this invariant.

version.description: The pinned declaration version or canonical content digest.

oneOf.description: A built-in rule, whose version identifies its predicate semantics.

id.description: The globally qualified built-in rule id.

DataQualitySeverity.description: How serious a data quality finding is.

oneOf.description: Informational evidence that needs no immediate action.
An expectation failed and should be reviewed.
The data blocks a normal workflow or projection.
The data presents an urgent integrity or authorization concern.

DataQualitySubject.description: An object affected by a finding.

FactRef.description:
One committed version of one object: the unit lineage cites.

Versions start at `1` and bump with every committed write to the object
(the cell's owner version), so `(objectType, key, version)` names one
immutable fact.

version.description: The object version this fact is.

InstanceProvenance.description:
Where one instance (or one version of it) came from: one record per
contributing source record. See the module docs.

mappingVersion.description: The mapping version that produced it.

markings.description:
Effective classifications propagated from the value-producing and
identity-source fields, guards, and parent collections. Omitted when
empty for older or unmarked facts.

observedAt.description: When the source system reported the record, when it says so.

source.description: The source record the fact was produced from.

sourceFields.description:
Source fields read by the value-producing expression, plus the map's
subject, source-record, and guard expressions, in mapping source order.
Nested property reads include the parent collection and qualified child
predicate/value fields (`collection.field`).
Omitted when unavailable or empty.

transform.description:
The transform within that mapping (a mapping rule id such as
`sales_order.header`); omitted when the mapping has one.

upstream.description:
The upstream facts the transform read, in mapping order. Omitted when
empty (the fact came from the source record alone).

InterfaceName.description:
Qualified name of an interface: the object type name grammar
([`OBJECT_TYPE_NAME_PATTERN`], `party.Party`). Interfaces and object types
share one name space.

InvariantId.description:
Id of an [`Invariant`], unique within its owner's effective invariant
contract. Same grammar as a property id ([`MEMBER_ID_PATTERN`]); invariants
have their own name space.

oneOf.description: An object type or one of its supertypes.
An interface implemented by the object type or one of its supertypes.

MappingVersion.description:
The version of the mapping that produced a fact
(`erpnext.sales_order@3`): the `Mapping` technical-view object it names.

MarkingId.description: Stable identity of a data marking.

ObjectTypeName.description:
Qualified name of an object type: dotted lower-case namespace segments and
a PascalCase type name (`retail.Sku`, `hr.Employee`), the form v1
`objectKind` already uses. The namespace segments are the type's domain
namespace ([`Self::domain`]).

PropertyId.description: Id of a property within its object type (`sku_code`), unique there.

SnapshotDeviationReason.description:
Why an observed lifecycle target cannot be reached by one unique shortest
path from the current state (or the lifecycle's initial state).

oneOf.description: No declared transition path reaches the observed target.
More than one shortest declared transition path reaches the target.

SourceRecordRef.description: The identity of one record in an external source system.

record.description: The record's identity in that system (`Sales Order/SO-1001`).

system.description:
The source system (`ERPNext`); the key of its `Source` technical-view
object. Contains no `/`.
